close_failure: the failed symbol is not marked closed; other symbols still close when their own checks pass
first_symbol_candle_failure: that symbol blocks new entries and still manages an existing position; later symbols run
programming_error: recorded as instrument_cycle_failed and does not skip later symbols
repeated_outages: no synthetic frame is bound and no mid price is recorded
reservation_policy: candle failure returns before order reservation; a close timeout is not retried
shared_state_failure: CycleIntegrityError stops the rest of the cycle
